## Civic data checklist

- [ ] No fabricated government data (officials, fees, requirements, contacts, statistics)
- [ ] Every new/changed civic fact has a source in `data/sources.ts`
- [ ] Every touched civic record has an accurate `lastChecked` date
- [ ] Conflicting sources are shown, not silently resolved
- [ ] The independent-project disclaimer is intact (BetterPagsanjan is not the LGU)
